newsitem.title: FRANCE: French police clash with youths after protests.
newsitem.headline: French police clash with youths after protests.

text.p: French police fired tear gas at several hundred young people at a rock concert in central Strasbourg on Saturday, hours after the end of a massive protest march against the rise of the far right National Front.
Police firing tear gas charged into the crowd of young poeople after the concert became unruly, with youths setting fire to a car and throwing bottles at police.
The march by opponents of the National Front drew an estimated 40,000 people to the eastern French city and passed off peacefully.
But afterwards some demonstrators threw bottles and eggs at police guarding the convention cente where the Front opened a three-day party congress. They also smashed some shop windows.
The Front was meeting to plan a strategy for breaking into the French parliament, where it currently has no seats, in general elections in March 1988.
